historical_behavior.finding: Purchase confirmation shows price, available balance, Yes-buy and No-go-back links; completion directs the user to Insert Emoticon from a chat menu. The historical free Default Pack is reported broken by the author.
historical_behavior.limits: Screenshot covers page flow, not server entitlement/expiry implementation.

historical_behavior.finding: Gift browse commands return names and prices as chat text. Search and display reveal matching products, category and rating.
historical_behavior.limits: Observed January2011 behavior; exact pagination, rate limits and transactions unknown.

selected_token_evidence.limits: Visible picker label only; cannot identify exact original download bytes or pack membership.

handset_glyph_observation.finding: Author reports these pasted characters render as emoticon glyphs in status and chat on some Java phones, and explicitly says support varies by handset. This is not BBCode or a recovered colour-code grammar.
handset_glyph_observation.backend_implication: Keep Unicode text intact; do not assign universal images or colours without a specific handset/font mapping.
